prompt: Review my HTML snippet for accessibility: ``
expected: Flag missing alt on the image and missing associated label for the input; placeholders are not labels.
actual: Called out the bare img without alt and the input that only has a placeholder. Recommended descriptive or empty alt based on intent, plus a real <label for> (or wrapping label) for the search field.

prompt: I want to make a website fast. Should I put all my CSS in one external file?
expected: Advise inlining critical CSS, deferring the rest, and tracking LCP/CLS/INP rather than FID.
actual: Recommended a small critical CSS path for above-the-fold content, deferring non-critical styles, optimizing the LCP image/fonts, and measuring Core Web Vitals with LCP, CLS, and INP.

prompt: Pre-launch checklist for a small brochure site?
expected: Cover forms, 404, favicon, lang/title, OG tags, sitemap/robots basics, HTTPS, and uptime without turning into a full SEO campaign.
actual: Walked launch.md items: working forms, helpful 404, favicon, html lang + titles, OG preview, sitemap/robots coherence, HTTPS, uptime monitor; pointed ranking strategy to seo when needed.
